_comment: Snapshot of expected hub test counts, from per-file-isolated `bun run check-baseline` (each hub/test file in its own process — Bun's mock.module is process-global and first-write-wins, so a shared process makes the suite order-dependent). The enforced gate is pass_min/skip_max/fail_max; pass/skip/total below are the informational actuals.
captured_from: Bare checkout, NO ambient env, NO database (the FLOOR configuration, per #348): `bun run check-baseline` → pass=1882 skip=240 fail=0 total=2122. RE-MEASURED on #354 (fix/dup-pty-writer), net +11 passes / +0 skips over #346's 1871/240: it ADDS pty-single-client-writer (11 — the turn-lock queue-spam guarantees, the last-writer-wins supersede, the write-path `not_current_writer` drop that muzzles a superseded socket, and the per-session `releaseWriterInSession` scoping) and re-points pty-turn-lock-release-by-writer at the same invariant without changing its count. The web-side leak test (web/test/pty-single-writer.test.tsx) is NOT counted here — check-baseline runs hub/test only. PRIOR baseline (#346): pass=1871 skip=240 fail=0 total=2111. RE-MEASURED on #346 (stop-the-bleed), net +32 passes / +9 skips over #349's 1839/231: it ADDS the circuit-breaker suite (5), token-cap-gate-fires (8), token-cap-coverage (3), stale-run-reaper (6), plus new cases in orchestrator-token-cap / supervisor-stopped-recovery, and the new Postgres-gated cases in finalize-orphaned-runs + the tokencap e2e (which SKIP without REMO_E2E_DB_URL — hence +9 skips here, all DB-gated with an explicit reason). PRIOR baseline (#349): pass=1839 skip=231 fail=0 total=2070. RE-MEASURED on #349 (safety fences), which is net +12 passes: it ADDS schema-sql-lint (12) + error-capture-snippet-envelope-contract (3) and the macro-path guard grew 4→5, while DELETING the legacy-wave rollback path — orchestrator-legacy-wave-parity.e2e (skips), the 6 makeCycleRunner wave tests in orchestrator-cycle-wiring, and 1 legacy-flag test in orchestrator-tick-reinject. CI (.woodpecker/qc.yaml) additionally exports REMO_E2E_DB_URL against a real postgres:16 service, which UN-SKIPS the e2e suites — so CI sees strictly MORE passes and FEWER skips than the numbers here. There are no inverse (run-only-without-a-DB) gates, so this floor is valid for both configurations.
_skip_note_once: Milestone once (feat/once-tasks) re-measured to actual pass=2004 skip=247 fail=0. ADDS once-tasks.test.ts (5, incl. the double-fire claim-lost guard) + once-work-sender.test.ts (6) + once-work-idempotency.test.ts (4, the dispatchWork per-work_id no-op) + the ext-work-containment (b) rewrite, and grows hub/test/e2e/schema-double-apply.e2e.test.ts by one REMO_E2E_DB_URL-gated case (the schedule_kind=once / task_type=work convergence check) — hence skip 246 -> 247, still an explicit DB-gated skip. Within tolerance (pass_min 1850, skip_max 248, fail_max 0); floor NOT raised.

tolerance._comment: pass_min is a REAL floor (1810 vs 1839 actual — ~1.5% headroom), not a formality. It was 700 against ~1827 actual passes, which meant roughly 1,100 tests could silently stop running and check-baseline would still print OK: a ratchet, not a gate. fail_max:0 only catches tests that RUN and fail — it cannot catch tests that vanish. That is what pass_min is for, so keep it tight. If you legitimately remove tests, RE-MEASURE and move it deliberately in the same PR and say why (#349 raised it 1800 -> 1810: the net count went UP even after deleting the legacy-wave path; #346 re-measured to 1871 actual and raised the floor 1810 -> 1840, keeping the same ~1.5% headroom, because it ADDS 32 tests; #354 re-measured to 1882 actual and raised the floor 1840 -> 1850, same ~1.7% headroom, because it ADDS 11 PTY single-client-writer tests). skip_max 245 vs 240 actual: EVERY skip in the suite is REMO_E2E_DB_URL-gated with an explicit reason — there are no unconditional or laundered skips. Keep it that way; a skip added for any other reason is a failure in disguise and must not be absorbed by this budget. fail_max stays 0.
tolerance._skip_note_work: Milestone WORK (feat/remo-work) re-measured to actual pass=1990 skip=246 fail=0. skip_max raised 245 -> 248: the extended hub/test/e2e/schema-double-apply.e2e.test.ts 'work_* tables converge' case is REMO_E2E_DB_URL-gated with an explicit reason (like every other skip in the suite), and #367's SKEY double-apply cases added the rest. No unconditional skips introduced. Pass floor kept at 1850 (~7% headroom vs 1990) — the WORK tests (ext-work-*, work-env-scrub, work-git) run without a DB and are counted in the 1990.
